DETAIL: Repair applicability and ownership: do not attach the StructuralMemberShape unconditionally to every hasStructuralMember value, since it makes the four section alternatives and both dimensional inputs mandatory for non-applicable members. Enforce inputs and the bounded formula only for members selected by a valid applicable section type. Use a canonical flat-bar controlled value compatible with structuralSectionType: the supplied flatBarSection has range frameProfileTypeValue, not structuralSectionTypeValue, so locate the appropriate missing canonical value. Also place webHeight and netWebThickness on their authoritative required owner (ship), rather than structuralMember, while retaining structuralSectionType on structuralMember and preserving the ship target/yieldStrength ownership.
